title: Combat feel: soft aim-assist (aim magnetism) toward nearby enemies (DD-012)
description:
Playtest feedback: aiming at enemies with the twin-stick feels fiddly. Implement SOFT aim-assist (magnetism) per DD-012 — NOT a hard lock-on. The player keeps full manual control; the assist only biases the cast aim toward an enemy the player is already roughly aiming at, and is fair/deterministic/legible per DD-001.

Mechanic (values PROVISIONAL, tune in playtest): when computing the cast aim direction, if the nearest enemy lies within an angular CONE (~±20deg) of the raw aim AND within RANGE (~400px), rotate the aim toward that enemy by a BOUNDED amount — full snap within an inner cone (~8deg), partial lerp between inner and outer cone, no assist outside the outer cone. Implement the core as a PURE, deterministic function (raw_aim: Vector2, player_pos, enemy_positions) -> assisted_aim: Vector2 (no RNG, no hidden state) so it's unit-testable headless. Wire it into the cast aim used by cast_primary/cast_secondary (scripts/player/player.gd `_aim`, and reflect it in scripts/player/reticle.gd so the reticle shows the assisted direction — DD-001 legibility). Find enemies via the existing 'enemies' group. Subtle target highlight on the assisted enemy is a nice-to-have. No new input/button, no persistent target-lock state.

MUST follow repo test hygiene: the pure-function tests are deterministic (no physics/Input). If any test instances live nodes, follow the InputGate seam + flake-aware conventions (run the suite multiple times). See memory gut-flake-await-input.
acceptance_criteria: A pure, deterministic aim-assist function exists (raw aim + player pos + enemy positions -> assisted aim) with no RNG/hidden state, unit-tested headless: assists toward an enemy inside the cone+range, does NOT assist when the enemy is outside the cone or beyond range, and leaves aim unchanged when no enemy qualifies.
The assist is wired into the player's cast aim (cast_primary/cast_secondary) so shots bias toward a nearby roughly-aimed-at enemy; manual aim outside the cone is respected (no takeover).
The reticle reflects the assisted direction (DD-001 legibility) so the player sees where the shot will go.
Cone/range/strength are exposed as tunable constants/@export (provisional values per DD-012), not magic numbers buried in logic.
Full GUT suite green exit 0 (run multiple times, flake-aware), gdlint clean, no new stderr noise; arena.tscn and sector_01.tscn still load clean.
